{% extends "!base.html" %} {# Announcement bar: the pre-1.0 API notice, and the work-in-progress notice. The first is on every build before 1.0 (`otto_api_notice`, from scripts/docs_api_reference.py's provisional_notice) and links to the API stability page. The second is on every off-tag build (`otto_dev_banner_text` / `otto_stable_docs_url`, from scripts/docs_build_stamp.py). Both come from html_context in conf.py, and each is None when it does not apply. The theme gates its whole
on `{% if self.announce() %}` (sphinx_immaterial/base.html), so this block MUST render to the empty string when neither applies, which from 1.0 on is a tagged build — whitespace alone is truthy in Jinja and would paint an empty banner across every released page. Hence the `{%- -%}` trimming throughout. #} {%- block announce -%} {%- if otto_api_notice -%} {{ otto_api_notice }} See API stability. {%- endif -%} {%- if otto_api_notice and otto_dev_banner_text -%}
{%- endif -%} {%- if otto_dev_banner_text -%} {{ otto_dev_banner_text }} For the latest release, see the stable documentation. {%- endif -%} {%- endblock -%}
